steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Mm! Hmm hmm~! Let's see... all the letters, specialty packages, high value insured mail-order goodies. All checked off.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Wonderful! That's all the work there is for today!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: What should I do first? Take a hot bath, maybe enjoy a cup of milk tea first? I still have a bit of that orange cream cake left.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Wait, stop it, Angelina! You promised yourself to keep your weight under... Uh, to eat healthier?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Howdy there, Angelina! Ya clockin' out too, huh? Wanna come along and check out the goodies I got comin' in?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Sure... *Yawn*.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Oh, sorry, Croissant. I couldn't fight that yawn. It's getting pretty late already.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well, ya see, I ordered a custom hairpin from that one accessory shop down in Lungmen ya pointed out last time.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya don't know the trouble I had to go through just to get the old man there to keep me ten of those trinkets. I guarantee there's something in there you'll like.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Oh, but...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: 'You'll get bags under yer eyes if ya turn in late,' right? Ya sound like a broken record, 'fcourse I know.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Alright, I'll keep yer stuff safe. Ya just come to me when you have time. Ya can count on good ol' Croissant to look after her friends!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Yep~ You're the best, Croissant!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Haha, if t'weren't for the fashion magazines ya lent me and all them notes you put in there, no way I could've picked out stuff that good.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: My last few hauls of clothes and accessories've been mighty popular with the folks at Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'm rakin' in a healthy hunk o' dough this month, much thanks to that. Let's get somethin' to eat come a day off next week.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What'cha like? Barbecue? Pizza? Maybe even them Yan hotpots?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Uh, that's music to my tummy and mouth... but...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But ya gotta 'keep yer weight in check,' right?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: ...I gotta eat healthy.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well, true, there's no need to worry about yer weight fer someone like you. Just sayin' so makes me jealous.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: How about we put out a little pamphlet next time? Somethin' like, '101 Weight Loss Tips for Cuties...'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Hold on, are you sure that'd sell?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: A girl can dream, can't she? Might could be there's some folks out there what don't know you, and are gullible enough.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Like that MountainDash boy who joined us last time. The li'l weightlifting contest you two had? Made me some decent money.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: We were picking on the new kid. Are you sure you should be gloating about it?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh, I'm just usin' information to my advantage. Whether it's business or Messenger work, information's king.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Hm... yeah, but it still... kinda bothers me a little. Maybe we'll treat Bison to some cake next time.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Alright, time to head home!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh, what's that by your door?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Oh... Is that a package? What's a package doing here?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I already delivered everything I got today.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: It's wrapped in pink, it smells nice, and it feels kinda... square? Probably a book.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Think it's them novels 'n magazines you like to read?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: The magazines show up at a set time every month, and I got everything I ordered this month already. There shouldn't be any more.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Besides, I've been getting quite a bit of delivery and logistics work lately. My schedule's so full, I haven't had time to read any new novels at all.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It's a present, then?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: A present? O-Of course not. Why would anyone give me a present?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Now that ain't all that wild, is it? Yer such a hottie, put two 'n two together.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: There's just no way, I'm telling you...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: It's not addressed to anyone. I'm guessing it came with something else and was meant to be delivered together.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I was kinda in a rush this morning, so it probably fell out of my bag by accident.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: *Sigh*, I screwed up again...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh, no big deal. You just gotta deliver it again!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Better get to it then.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh, now? Tomorrow'd be a-okay, yeah? You just said it's gettin' late.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Someone once told me, 'If you are to correct your mistakes, there is no time better than the present.'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: We've been to a few places already, but we still haven't found who the package is for.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: There aren't any clues or anything on the thing itself, so I guess we're gonna have to keep trying every place I delivered to today.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Sorry, Croissant. I didn't mean to have you run all over the place with me.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I tagged along 'cause I wanted to.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: 'sides, get in some exercise at night and you wake up all bright-eyed and bushy-tailed the next day.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You sure you ain't tired? You been runnin' all up and down.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I'm fine... Well, maybe a little, but it's nothing compared to how worried and disappointed the recipient of the package is.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well, if that ain't proof that you're one of the finest Messengers there is, I don't know what is.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: R-Really? I always thought I still have a long way to go.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh, reminds me of when I first came to Rhodes Island. This real pretty high school girl came up to me, asking me to teach her how to be a better Messenger. I was real surprised!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: That just tells you how amazing Penguin Logistics is! I mean, it was founded by that Emperor! I'd already heard of you guys when I was still back home!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I knew right away you must be a great Messenger when I saw you carrying all those packages like it was nothing, so that's why I mustered up the courage to talk to you.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Great Messenger! Haha, I wish you'd told Texas or the Baws that! Could've gotten me a raise or somethin'.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Thinking back, I just felt like I could never do anything right when I first got here... I'm glad you're here, Croissant.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? I ain't done nothin'! Does that time you lost a package 'n started crying, and I handed you some tissues count?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I wasn't just crying because I lost a package...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit said I could choose a combat assignment or go to Logistics, where I would get some long-term field ops like the other Messengers getting treatment on the ship.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: And I chose combat.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit agreed with my decision since she thought my abilities could be put to good use on the battlefield after some training.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: But, deep down in my heart, I was still uncertain about a lot of things.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So why'd you decide to start fightin' anyway, Angelina? You don't look like the clobberin' type.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I... Well, I guess it's probably because I want to be just a little more awesome.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I don't want to give anyone trouble, and I don't want to always have to hide behind everyone else.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I wanted to become an adult who could stand on her own right away. Just like Dr. Kal'tsit and... and... like {@nickname}.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I guess that probably makes me kinda greedy? I wanted to go to the front lines, but I didn't want to give up my work as a Messenger either.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I couldn't do anything well back then, and all that training would always leave me exhausted each and every day.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Then, the next day, I'd find Rhodes Island in a completely different place than the day before. I didn't even know how to get anywhere when I had to make deliveries...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Is that why you were cryin' your eyes out all a sudden?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well yank my tail and call me Sora! I sure am a dummy for missin' that!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: No, you're not. You were so patient and helped me find my way. You were my hero.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Haha, that's just how you take care of a rookie! We all gotta start somewhere!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And how can you call yourself greedy? Workin' yer fluff off all 'cause you wanna get better? That's darned normal, if you ask me.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Take yours truly, I'm giving hustlin' every day just to make myself more money!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Yeah, and I'm always trying to learn from you.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? What do ya mean?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Well, you don't ever get hung up on the things that don't matter...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Even when you're working on your Rhodes Island missions, you always have a couple dozen packages with completely different delivery routes, and you always have the day's purchases figured out on top of that! You're like a superstar mentor!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Whoowee, I sure didn't know I was that amazin.' All I ever do is try my darndest to git 'er done, 'n beat up all the bad guys what come my way like, bam bam bam!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Just like that! Bam bam!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: When you get to whacking, it's like it blows away all the worries on my mind.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh, when you put it like that, it makes a girl blush.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And ya know, I always thought you were one amazin' girl yerself. That's as a Rhodes Island operator and as a Messenger.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And I know I ain't nothin' like you.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: The reason I became a Messenger is cause the Baws is sincere and honest and got plenty of money. It so happens I'm good at it, and the gals make it a mighty fun place to be.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You ain't like me. Yer passionate about this line o' work, and ya actually care about how the senders 'n recipients feel.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Actually, that's exactly the reason I became a Messenger.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: No kiddin'?!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Back when I'd just left home, for the first few days, all I could do was hide in an old neighborhood close by. I didn't go out until nighttime because I was too afraid.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: It was almost winter. The wind was humid and chilly, and I was still wearing the skirt I wore on my last day to school. My whole body had gone all numb.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I was like an aimless ghost just wandering around.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Then, a Messenger found me, or should I say I found him?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: He was delivering letters right next door.  When they got the letters, the recipients smiled at him, and it felt like that smile was for me too. It kind of... warmed me up a little.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And that's how you became a Messenger?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: The opportunity was right there, so I took it. I had lots to learn, and it was all very difficult, but it was also very fulfilling.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: After that, I started to believe that your interpersonal relationships are what really make you feel real, alive, existent.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Ever since I left all the people that knew me, this Angelina has started to fade away bit by bit.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh, sounds horrible.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Yeah, looking back, I guess it kind of does.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: After that, I started giving delivery a shot.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: To my surprise, each and every time I hand over a package or a letter to somebody, the smiles on their faces did truly give me something.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: It's only during these times that... I feel like I've come a little closer to all those emotions I once knew.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: So I kept delivering. I kept experiencing those emotions between people, and I began to slowly find who I once was, who Angelina used to be.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You ain't the only one who gets those feelings, y'know? Them recipients get all glopped up by yer earnestness just the same. Like that pawpaw just now. You saw how happy he was to see you again?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Too bad. He said the package wasn't his.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'I got a grandson working out in the cities. He sent me that package of souvenirs—'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'They're some really sweet tangerines.'

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: 'That book you got is probably meant for somebody else. I'm old. My eyes aren't what they used to be. Neo wouldn't send me a book.'

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well, he's right. A good grandson wouldn't send his pawpaw things he couldn't use.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gotta say, though... These are some darn sweet tangerines.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Not only did we not do anything, he even shared his souvenirs with us.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Life's little corners're full o' surprises. Just on this trip, we got us some tangerines, 'n we also almost got beat up. Who'd'a thunk it?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Well, I didn't expect the same guy who ordered the new 'Moon & Lavender' velvet scarf and pajamas set would turn into some dangerous gangster at night!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: If I'd known, I wouldn't have asked him if he ordered a new 'Moon & Lavender' catalogue outright like an idiot!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That was so funny, though! Cracked me right up!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: That's right. Everyone could hear you laugh.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Just thinkin' about that scar-faced guy, how he'n and them two other fellers looked! If you said just one more word, they just might'a put us six feet under! Hahahaha...

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: I feel kinda bad, though. Maybe he really didn't want anyone else to know he bought that? That was my mistake. Thank goodness you were there to smooth things over.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: 'Much appreciated, Baws. We hope you and the lady will be satisfied with yer purchase today. Next time, how 'bout a catalogue too~?'

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sounds just like a salesperson, no?

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Yeah, very professional.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Great! Gotta get it memorized, then! The next time I go on deliveries, maybe I should take this on as a side job! Can't get enough side jobs!

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: He's probably really fond of that item, though... I can't imagine him spending this much on insurance otherwise. I sure hope he'll be able to share his hobbies with everyone someday, openly.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: This might just be the significance we Messengers have. It keeps him that much more at ease when it's a stranger that delivers his items.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: But I betrayed his trust this time.

steps.name: Angelina
steps.text: Looks like I gotta work even harder.
